_comment: Copy to identity.json and fill in. This is how parsers know which messages are YOURS (direction = sent/out) vs others. Nothing here leaves your machine.

handles.instagram: Your Name As It Appears In IG Export

_notes.instagram: Use the exact sender_name string from your IG message JSON (open one message_1.json and copy the value).
_notes.google_voice: Google Voice marks your own messages with the literal name 'Me' - leave as 'Me' unless yours differs.
_notes.twitter: Numeric account ID from account.js (accountId), not the display handle.
